data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Sumsub Mobile SDK, enabling identity verification in mobile apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides access to Sumsub Mobile SDK features, allowing users to submit documents and perform KYC checks within Flutter apps.
use_when: When you need KYC/identity verification in a Flutter app
When you want to integrate Sumsub's mobile SDK
avoid_when: When you don't need identity verification
When you prefer a different verification provider
data.setup_notes: Add plugin to pubspec, configure Android and iOS per Sumsub docs, add permissions for camera and storage
